title: Prevalence of Complaints of Discrimination and Unfair Treatment in Police Force and Involvement of External Experts in Reviews
what_it_is: Prevalence of Complaints of Discrimination and Unfair Treatment in Police Force and Involvement of External Experts in Reviews

sections.label: Police prejudice complaint statistics
sections.summary: MP asks for five years of internal prejudice, discrimination and unfair treatment allegations in the Singapore Police Force and their percentage of total officers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) for each year in the past five years, how many internal allegations and complaints of prejudice, discrimination or unfair treatment are handled in the Singapore Police Force; and (b) what is the respective percentage of such allegations and complaints against the total number of police officers.
